title: Console UI: Route detail page with model breakdown + deltas
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)
description:
Build the Route Detail page in the console for Usage Insights.

This page is entered from the Route List (ENG-8426) and answers:
- For a given route, what is the total cost and usage over the selected period?
- Which models (and model variants) are driving spend/latency/error rate for this route?
- What changed vs the prior period (delta + % change)?

Scope
1) Route header summary
- Route identifier (canonical route string as displayed; include a “copied” affordance)
- Time range selector (shared control) and active filters chips (env/region/org/project/deployment)
- Summary metrics for selected window:
  - Total cost
  - Total requests
  - Total tokens (input + output)
  - p50 latency, p95 latency
  - Error rate
- “Compare to prior period” toggle (on by default if prior period exists): show delta and % for each summary metric.

2) Model breakdown module (chart + table)
- A compact visualization at top (stacked bar or donut) showing spend share by model for the route.
- A table listing top models used for this route, sorted by Total cost desc by default.
- Columns (MVP):
  - Model (display name + variant if present)
  - Total cost
  - Cost delta vs prior period (absolute + %)
  - Requests
  - Input tokens, Output tokens, Cached tokens
  - Unit cost (cost / 1K tokens) [see Definitions]
  - p50 latency, p95 latency
  - Error rate
- Table interactions:
  - Pagination (server-driven) and “Top N” limit (match API contract)
  - Click row -> open right-side drawer with “Model details for this route” (optional, stretch)
  - Download/Export lives on overall page header (not per-model), handled by ENG-8425

3) What changed panel
- A small “What changed” list of top deltas for the route:
  - Top 3 models with biggest cost increase
  - Biggest latency regression (p95) among models (if enough volume)
  - New models appearing in period (present now but absent prior)
- This panel is meant to be narrative + triage-oriented and should degrade gracefully when prior period data is missing.

Non-goals
- Cross-route comparisons (belongs on Route List)
- Alerting / anomaly detection beyond compare-to-prior deltas
- Arbitrary custom dimensions beyond route/model

Definitions (metrics shown)
- Total cost: attributed USD cost for requests mapped to this route in the selected window.
- Input tokens: tokens in the prompt/messages.
- Output tokens: tokens generated.
- Cached tokens: tokens served from prefix/KV cache where metering reports as cached. (Note: exact semantics depend on metering pipeline; see Support known issues.)
- Unit cost: Total cost / ((Input tokens + Output tokens) / 1000). Display as $/1K tokens.
  - Important: If Cached tokens are metered as discounted, unit cost implicitly reflects that.
- Latency p50/p95: end-to-end request latency at the gateway (where available), aggregated for the selected window and dimensions.
- Error rate: (5xx + explicit model inference failures) / requests. Exclude client disconnects if flagged as such by telemetry.

UX requirements
- Empty states:
  - If route exists but no data for window: show empty state with suggestion to widen time range.
  - If “Unknown route”: show callout pointing to route tagging docs + SDK links.
  - If missing prior period: hide compare deltas and show helper text.
- Loading states:
  - Skeleton for summary + table (avoid layout shift)
  - “Partial data” banner if API indicates pipeline lag beyond SLO (if field exists; otherwise defer)
- Accessibility:
  - Table is keyboard navigable; chart has text alternative
  - Color palette must pass contrast; do not encode meaning in color alone

Performance requirements
- Route detail page should render usable content (header + summary) within 1.5s on typical broadband after navigation from route list.
- Must not request unbounded datasets; rely on API pagination and default Top N.
- Avoid re-fetch loops when filter chips update; debounce where appropriate.

Implementation notes
- Gate behind feature flag: console.usageInsights.routeDetail (same umbrella as list view).
- API: use route detail endpoint from ENG-8424.
- Keep URL stable and shareable:
  - /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/usage/insights/routes/:routeId?start=…&end=…&env=…&region=…
  - routeId is the normalized/encoded route key returned from the list endpoint (not raw customer input).

References
- Confluence PRD: In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)
- Design spec: Console usage insights route/model breakdown
- API contract addendum: usage insights analytics endpoints

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Navigating from Route List to Route Detail loads detail for the correct route key.
- [ ] Summary cards show correct values for the selected window; compare toggle updates deltas.
- [ ] Model breakdown table matches API fields and sorting; pagination works.
- [ ] Unit cost is computed and displayed consistently ($/1K tokens) with correct denominator.
- [ ] Deltas handle missing prior data without showing NaN/empty placeholders.
- [ ] Empty states implemented for no-data, unknown route, and missing tagging scenarios.
- [ ] Feature flag controls visibility (off by default in prod).
- [ ] Basic analytics events: page_view, filter_change, model_row_click (if drawer implemented).

QA notes
- Verify with a route known to have multi-model fallback (smart routing) to ensure model breakdown sums to route totals (within rounding).
- Verify with a low-volume route (p95 latency may be absent or unstable; ensure UI messaging).

Open questions
- Do we want to show GPU time proxy on this page (column) or keep it for later? Currently out of MVP unless already present in route detail API.
- How do we want to handle rounding so that model costs sum to route total (e.g., show “Other” bucket or allow small mismatch note)?
comments: 2026-02-06 (Felix Schneider): Started wiring the route detail page route -> API. Using the routeKey from the list response (not raw string) to avoid issues with encoding and normalization changes.

2026-02-08 (Tessa Morgan): For the model breakdown chart, prefer a compact stacked bar above the table (better for scanning than donut). Ensure legend is keyboard accessible; add text summary like “Top model: llama-3.1-70b-instruct (42% of spend)”.

2026-02-10 (Chloe Martin): Please avoid client-side aggregation for deltas; the API is already returning prior period metrics and deltas. Also watch query count: ideally 1 call for header+table, not separate calls per module.

2026-02-12 (Allison Grant): Add a placeholder for “data freshness” banner but don’t block the page on it; we’ll follow up once the backend exposes lag in the response. Make sure errors show a retry affordance and log to Sentry with routeKey + filters.

2026-02-15 (Paula Mendes): Unit cost must be $/1K tokens (input+output). Cached tokens should remain a separate column; avoid subtracting cached from total tokens unless we’re explicit. Add tooltip explaining cached tokens and link to FAQ.

2026-02-18 (Felix Schneider): Implemented summary cards + table with server pagination. Compare toggle works; if priorPeriod is null, we hide deltas and show helper text “Prior period data unavailable for this range”. PR up shortly.
2026-02-20 (Dylan Brooks): Please ensure URL is shareable (query params). Also add “Copy route name” button in header; it’s a common ask from CS when customers are cleaning up naming conventions.
